clauses.requirement: Retro-reflecting devices (Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB) shall be tested per the chronological order of tests in Table 4 across samples a to j, beginning with a visual inspection for general specifications on all ten samples.

Per Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB), all samples shall undergo visual inspection of shapes and dimensions (Annex 5), heat test 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C (Part 1 of Annex 6) with visual inspection for distortion, colorimetry (para 4.2; trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) and limited photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° (Part 1 of Annex 4); complete photometry on the designated samples; designated samples shall undergo water test (Part 3 of Annex 6) 10 min in normal and 10 min in inverted position, motor fuels 5 min (Part 1 of Annex 7), oils 5 min (Part 2 of Annex 7), corrosion 24 h, 2 h interval, 24 h, and rear face test 1 min (Part 4 of Annex 6), each followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and limited photometry as specified; stability in time (Part 3 of Annex 4) and resistance to weathering (Part 6 of Annex 6) shall be followed by colorimetry (visual or trichromatic) and limited photometry.

Retro-reflecting devices of Class IVA shall be tested per the chronological order in Table 5 across samples a to j: general and shape/dimension visual inspection on all samples; heat 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C with distortion inspection, colorimetry and limited photometry (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) on all samples; complete photometry on designated samples; water test (Part 2 of Annex 6) 10 min normal and 10 min inverted; motor fuels 5 min; oils 5 min; corrosion 24 h, 2 h interval, 24 h; rear face 1 min (Part 4 of Annex 6); impact (Part 4 of Annex 8); each followed by visual inspection, colorimetry (trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) and limited photometry as specified.

The approval communication shall include a concise description stating whether the device is in isolation or part of an assembly of devices, the colour of light emitted (white/red/amber), whether installed as an integral part of a lamp integrated into the vehicle body (yes/no), geometric installation conditions and any variations, and whether only for limited mounting height of 750 mm or less above the ground (yes/no); inapplicable entries shall be struck out.
The approval communication shall state the position of the approval mark or Unique Identifier (UI).
The approval communication shall state whether approval is granted, refused, extended or withdrawn, striking out what does not apply.
The approval communication shall state the reason(s) for the extension, if applicable.
The approval communication shall state the place of issue.
